sections.text: Hugo Thorvaldsen has charged into the ARC-3 top 25, climbing from 441st to 25th in the past day. The entry gained 5.82 points to reach 35.49.
The surge brings the entry closer to the provisional gold places. The last of the 18 gold places now requires 36.89, leaving Thorvaldsen below the line as the chase tightens.
